connection_condition: Each atom's molecule reference carries the identifier of the molecule that owns it, and each atom belongs to exactly one molecule.
description: A molecule is composed of its atoms. Removing a molecule makes its atoms meaningless, and aggregating a molecule's atoms by element yields the molecule's element composition.

connection_condition: Each bond's molecule reference carries the identifier of the owning molecule; bond identifiers are prefixed with that molecule identifier.
description: A molecule is composed of its bonds. Bond type and bond endpoints are properties of a molecule's internal structure.

connection_condition: The bond-atom incidence table pairs each bond with exactly two atoms of the same molecule; the bond identifier also names those two atom sequence numbers.
description: A bond is composed of the two atoms it joins. This is part-of rather than is-a: an atom is a component of a bond, not a type of bond.

connection_condition: Each atom row stores exactly one lowercase element symbol.
description: Every atom carries one chemical element. Element is an attribute of an atom and does not have an independent identifier beyond its symbol value.

connection_condition: Each bond row stores one bond type symbol.
description: Every bond has exactly one bond type, except the single bond whose stored type is empty.

connection_condition: The label table assigns at most one label per molecule identifier; the linkage is the molecule identifier.
description: A molecule may carry a carcinogenicity label. The label is stored only at molecule grain and does not exist for 101 of the 444 structurally present molecules.
A carcinogenic molecule is a molecule whose label is '+'. The carcinogenic molecules are a subset of all molecules, with a strictly narrower value domain.
A non-carcinogenic molecule is a molecule whose label is '-'. Unlabeled molecules are not members of this subset because their status is unknown.

connection_condition: Counting a molecule's atoms grouped by their element symbol produces the molecule's element composition.
description: Molecule element composition is derived from the atoms of the molecule together with their element symbols.

connection_condition: Presence for a molecule-element pair follows from the corresponding composition count being at least one.
description: Element presence is derived from element composition: a molecule contains an element exactly when its composition count for that element is positive.

connection_condition: Counting the distinct bonds recorded for an atom in the incidence table yields that atom's bond count.
description: Atom bond count is derived from bond-atom incidence; atoms with no incidence rows have a count of zero.

connection_condition: Summing the per-molecule composition counts for a symbol over a molecule population yields the element atom count for that population.
description: Population-level element atom counts are derived by aggregating molecule element composition over the chosen molecule population.

connection_condition: The element atom count is divided by the chosen population size, either the population's total atom count or its molecule count, and multiplied by 100.
description: Element percentage is derived from the element atom count and the size of the named population; the population denominator determines which reading applies.

connection_condition: The count of molecules labeled '+' is divided by the count of labeled molecules and multiplied by 100.
description: The carcinogenic molecule percentage is derived from the carcinogenic molecule count and the labeled molecule population.

connection_condition: The count of bonds of a type within a bond population is divided by that population's bond count and multiplied by 100.
description: Bond type percentage is derived from the bond type distribution over the named bond population.
Carcinogenic molecule percentage is a percentage share whose population is molecules.
Element percentage is a percentage share whose population is a set of molecules or their atoms.
Bond type percentage is a percentage share whose population is a set of bonds.
